STRUCTURE: One HTML file with inline CSS and inline vanilla JavaScript. Exactly one 800x800 <canvas> centered horizontally and vertically on a dark page background. Load dat.gui ONLY from its official CDN (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js) — no other external libraries, frameworks, modules, images, fonts or assets. Code comments in English, short, explaining major sections. No mention of any game, movie, brand or franchise anywhere in code or comments.

EXACT PALETTE (used as defaults): background #05070f, background glow #101a3a, main branch color #00e5ff, secondary branch accent #d6ff00, synapse color #ff2bd6, pulse color #fff36a, UI accent #ffd400, optional scanline/grid overlay color rgba(0,229,255,0.08). Look: futuristic, high contrast, glowing, slightly gritty. Neon glow achieved with ctx.shadowBlur and shadowColor.

dat.gui PANEL: one gui, organized into 4 folders named exactly "Growth", "Synapses", "Pulses", "Visuals".
- Growth folder: neuronCount (3-8, default 4), growthSpeed (0.2-5), maxDepth (2-8), splitChance (0-1), curvature (0-1), maxLength (40-220).
- Synapses folder: synapseDistance (threshold, 5-120), glowStrength (0-30).
- Pulses folder: pulseSpeed (0.2-6), pulseFrequency (0.1-8), pulseBrightness (0.2-3).
- Visuals folder: bgColor (#05070f), branchColor (#00e5ff), accentColor (#d6ff00), synapseColor (#ff2bd6), pulseColor (#fff36a) — all as dat.gui color pickers that take effect live.
- Three top-level gui buttons/functions: "regenerate network" (reseeds and regrows), "clear canvas" (clears drawing but keeps network), "pause/resume animation" (toggles rAF updates; label may stay same).

SIMULATION LOGIC:
1. Setup: generate 3-6 seed neurons at random positions within ~200px of canvas center; store everything in plain arrays/objects only.
2. Neuron growth: each neuron grows recursive branching lines ANIMATED over frames (a small growth step per frame per active tip, not instant). Each branch has an angle that jitters slightly each step, and the drawn segment uses quadraticCurveTo with a control point for smooth organic curvature. Branch thickness varies slightly (thin neon lines, e.g. 0.6-2.5px, thinner with depth). Occasionally spawn a smaller side branch (governed by splitChance). Respect maxDepth, maxLength, a global branch-count cap (e.g. 700) and per-neuron tip cap so performance stays stable. Some branches use accentColor for variety.
3. Synapse detection: each frame (or every few frames), compare active branch tips across DIFFERENT branches/neurons; when two tips come within synapseDistance, create a synapse object {ax, ay, bx, by, phase}; skip creation if a synapse already exists between the same two branches (dedupe by branch id pair, small cap on total synapses e.g. 120).
4. Pulse animation: once growth is complete (stable size reached), continuously spawn random electric pulses at random synapses/paths over time (rate governed by pulseFrequency). Each pulse travels along its connection (or a chain of 2-3 connected synapses) using linear interpolation of position with t in [0,1] advanced by pulseSpeed; drawn as a short bright spark (small glowing line/dot in pulseColor, brightness scaled by pulseBrightness) with stronger shadowBlur. Keep active pulse count bounded (e.g. 60).

RENDERING (every frame via requestAnimationFrame, delta-time based):
- Fill background with bgColor; draw a soft radial background glow (background glow color #101a3a) around center using a radial gradient.
- Faint static grid or scanlines drawn with rgba(0,229,255,0.08), plus subtle animated noise/flicker lines for grit (lightweight — a few translucent lines, not per-pixel loops over the whole canvas every frame; a cached offscreen noise pattern refreshed occasionally is acceptable but keep it simple).
- Draw branches: thin glowing strokes, shadowBlur around 6-10, main color branchColor with some accentColor branches.
- Draw synapses: small glowing nodes/brights, glow stronger than branches (shadowBlur scaled by glowStrength), brightness gently oscillating with time (sin of phase).
- Draw pulses as moving sparks.
- Vignette: radial gradient from transparent center to dark edges drawn last.
- Trails: instead of full clear each frame, optionally fill background with slight alpha for subtle motion trails — but ensure it doesn't accumulate incorrectly when paused; a clean approach: full bg fill each frame is fine too.

PERFORMANCE: no particle systems, no physics engines, no pathfinding; O(tips^2) tip proximity check is acceptable given caps; target smooth 60fps.

Keep total code compact (roughly 300-450 lines), simple, readable, with section comments: // ===== Setup =====, // ===== GUI =====, // ===== Neuron growth =====, // ===== Synapse detection =====, // ===== Pulse animation =====, // ===== Rendering =====, and a main loop. Handle window resize gracefully (canvas stays 800x800, centered via CSS flexbox). Pause must stop updates but the page should resume correctly."}
